name: New World
summary:
# Your desk, anywhere you want to be
Pick a place and get to work. Each one has its own music and light that follows your day.

- **Orbit:** a library circling the Earth, with a holodeck of real spacecraft
- **Seoul:** a hanok tea room above the city
- **Seabreeze:** a palm lagoon to unwind between sessions

# Bring your computer
Install the free New World Desktop app on your Windows PC, enter a six-digit code, and your screens appear round your desk, with your PC's sound if you want it. Your real keyboard
